about: The legal identity behind the site (§ 5 DDG, § 18 MStV). CONTENT, not code: Karl types these values; scripts/check-legal.mjs refuses a build when any is empty or a placeholder, and checks that content/legal/impressum.md carries the same name, street, city and e-mail. No phone, no register entry and no VAT id are printed until Karl supplies them.
name: Karl Würfel
